what: While the 500vh section stays pinned to the screen, six photo (video) tiles of different widths, heights and vertical positions drift sideways behind the centered copy. Each tile runs x from 60 to screen width − strip width − 80·screen width/tile width, so smaller tiles travel farther and stagger against each other. It starts when 10% of the section touches the top of the screen, ends when 90% touches the bottom, and follows late with scrub 1.5 (no curve)

options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage that sticks to the screen (sticky)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Horizontal strip — --fx-track times the screen width (default 152.29%, 230vh on phones), column width is --fx-cols (grid-template-columns)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Flowing cell — vertical offset --fx-lift (%, relative to cell height)
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: (If present) centered copy floating over the cell
options.pad: Trailing trim (inversely proportional to cell width), default 80
options.scrub: Follow-behind delay (s), default 1.5 — if true, immediate
